risks.title: Qualified Personnel Turnover Risk
risks.summary: Munich Re relies heavily on its qualified employees to implement its strategy. If working conditions are not attractive compared to competitors, the company risks high staff turnover and loss of critical skills.
risks.score_rationale: Risk explicitly identified in the middle of the report as 'staff turnover risk' with 'strategic relevance' qualification. Moderate language ('can counteract') but strong strategic context: insufficient working conditions threaten retention of critical talent for an expertise-based financial services company. Stable trend but permanent structural risk. Key person category = high weight.

risks.title: Human Rights Violations Risk in Supply Chain
risks.summary: Munich Re must comply with the German Supply Chain Due Diligence Act (LkSG) regarding human rights. For indirect investments, compliance cannot be fully guaranteed, creating regulatory non-compliance risk.
risks.score_rationale: Risk located in early-middle section of report with explicit reference to German LkSG (Supply Chain Due Diligence Act). Cautious language ('cannot be fully ensured') regarding indirect investments. Stable trend but new/increased risk linked to strengthening European regulation. Regulation category = high weight.

risks.title: Workplace Discrimination and Harassment Risk
risks.summary: Although Munich Re applies a zero-tolerance policy, the risk of discrimination or harassment exists in any company. Incidents could result in litigation, fines, or damages.
risks.score_rationale: Risk explicitly named in middle of report with mention of 'zero-tolerance policy' and establishment of formal structures (complaints office in Germany). Moderate language but acknowledgment that 'negative impacts can arise in any company'. Stable trend (zero incidents in 2025 and prior year). Litigation category = medium-high weight.

risks.title: Workload Overload and Work-Life Imbalance Risk
risks.summary: Excessive workload or poor work-life balance could reduce employee satisfaction and increase staff turnover, affecting operational performance.
risks.score_rationale: Risk identified in middle of report among potential working condition risks. Moderate language ('lack of opportunities') without dramatic intensity. Stable trend, common structural risk in financial sector. Industrial category = medium weight.

risks.title: Insufficient Controversial Weapons Exclusion Risk
risks.summary: Munich Re commits to excluding direct investments in controversial weapons, but risk persists if control processes are not rigorously applied or if new weapons emerge.
risks.score_rationale: Risk located at beginning of report concerning direct investments in controversial weapons (anti-personnel mines, cluster munitions). Clear language ('exclude any direct investment') but risk limited to listed direct investments. Stable trend, well-controlled risk. Regulation category = high weight but severity mitigated by existing controls.

risks.title: Fair Compensation Standards Non-Compliance Risk
risks.summary: Insufficient or inequitable compensation could violate growing legal standards and reduce Munich Re's attractiveness to qualified talent.
risks.score_rationale: Implicit risk in middle of report mentioning 'inadequate salary' among working condition risks. Moderate language without urgency. Stable trend, structural risk linked to growing legal obligations regarding pay equity. Regulation category = high weight.
